create_patchembed_default: create a PatchEmbed instance with default 224x224 image size and 16x16 patch size
create_patchembed_custom: create a PatchEmbed with custom image size, patch size, and embedding dimension
create_patchembed_norm: create a PatchEmbed with a normalization layer applied to patch embeddings
run_patchembed_forward: run the forward pass of PatchEmbed on a batch of image tensors
review_patchembed_class: review the PatchEmbed class and its 2D image to patch embedding logic
